Looking for an internship where I can apply my skills to real-world, impactful software projects while continuing to grow as an engineer.

projects.title: Code Pulse
projects.description: A SaaS platform for automated code review and technical debt tracking on registered GitHub repositories. Integrated GitHub webhooks routed through reviewdog for automated review, with a pipeline that computes technical debt metrics and surfaces them via a live dashboard and mobile notifications. Uses RabbitMQ as the message queue between microservices.

projects.title: Medi-center
projects.description: A full-stack multi-role healthcare marketplace connecting patients with nearby doctors, pharmacies, and AI-assisted medicine information, with Public, Registrar, and Admin roles, JWT authentication, and admin approval for healthcare providers. Includes location-based doctor/pharmacy discovery using the Haversine formula and Leaflet/OpenStreetMap, a medicine ordering system with prescription uploads and Stripe Checkout, and an AI health assistant with a rule-based medicine database.

projects.title: S4-AgriSmart
projects.description: A Semester 4 group project exploring cloud-native deployment on AWS, using Kubernetes (k3s) and ArgoCD for GitOps-based continuous delivery of containerized services.
